gate_status: Phase 13.3 Docker/Container Audit Complete — Remediation Pending

findings.title: Docker Compose postgres_data external volume dependency
findings.exact_evidence: docker-compose.yml lines 311-314 declare volume 'postgres_data' with 'external: true' and 'name: medmatch_postgres_data'.
findings.impact: docker compose up fails immediately on a clean checkout with volume not found error, breaking standard developer and CI startup.
findings.recommended_remediation: Convert postgres_data to a standard managed local named volume in docker-compose.yml.

findings.title: Missing healthchecks for AI Service and Celery Worker in Compose
findings.exact_evidence: Neither ai-service nor worker has a HEALTHCHECK instruction in their Dockerfile or in docker-compose.yml. In compose, frontend depends on ai-service via 'condition: service_started'.
findings.impact: Frontend Nginx reverse proxy routes requests to AI service before FastAPI is ready, resulting in 502 Bad Gateway errors for early user traffic.
findings.recommended_remediation: Add an HTTP healthcheck to ai-service in docker-compose.yml and update frontend depends_on condition to service_healthy.

findings.title: Model duplication and dead-weight HuggingFace cache in runtime image
findings.exact_evidence: Stage 1 of ai-service.Dockerfile downloads all-MiniLM-L6-v2 to /opt/huggingface. Stage 2 copies /opt/huggingface into the runtime image AND copies services/ai-service/models into ./models. EmbeddingModel exclusively loads from /app/models/all-MiniLM-L6-v2, leaving /opt/huggingface completely unused.
findings.impact: Inflates clean Docker build time with an unnecessary remote model download and bloats production images with ~100MB+ of unused files.
findings.recommended_remediation: Remove the Stage 1 remote model download and COPY /opt/huggingface statement. Rely exclusively on the pre-baked model in /app/models.

findings.title: Kubernetes AI Service liveness probe timeout window without startupProbe
findings.exact_evidence: ai-service/deployment.yaml lines 203-214 define liveness probe with initialDelaySeconds: 30, periodSeconds: 15, failureThreshold: 3 (total 75s). No startupProbe is declared.
findings.impact: If cold storage or CPU throttling (100m request) pushes model and PyTorch initialization beyond 75s, Kubernetes kills the container and initiates a CrashLoopBackOff.
findings.recommended_remediation: Add a startupProbe to ai-service/deployment.yaml targeting /api/health/live with up to 150s grace period.

findings.title: Redundant separate Celery worker build definition
findings.exact_evidence: worker.Dockerfile duplicates 80% of ai-service.Dockerfile but diverged by omitting alembic migration files. In Kubernetes, the worker deployment already overrides the command to celery.
findings.impact: Doubles CI build times, registry storage, and vulnerability scan overhead while introducing maintenance drift risks.
findings.recommended_remediation: Consolidate into a single medmatch-ai-service image and override command to celery in worker deployment.

findings.title: Mutable image tags in production manifests
findings.exact_evidence: Kubernetes manifests reference mutable tags ':latest' and ':phase2-migrations' with 'imagePullPolicy: Always'.
findings.impact: Non-deterministic production deployments, broken rollback guarantees, and mandatory registry dependency on every pod restart.
findings.recommended_remediation: Pin production deployments to immutable semantic version tags or sha256 image digests.

findings.title: Test dependencies installed in production images
findings.exact_evidence: services/ai-service/requirements.txt includes pytest and pytest-mock, which are installed into the runtime image virtualenv.
findings.impact: Unnecessary testing tools in production container increase image size and attack surface.

findings.title: Worker initContainer executes as root
findings.exact_evidence: init-uploads initContainer in worker/deployment.yaml specifies runAsUser: 0 to chmod 777 /app/uploads.
findings.impact: Violates restricted Pod Security Standards by running a root container and creating world-writable directories.
findings.recommended_remediation: Use securityContext.fsGroup: 1000 in Pod spec instead of root chown/chmod initContainer.

findings.title: Subdirectory .dockerignore files ignored in root-context builds
findings.exact_evidence: Root context builds only respect the root .dockerignore. Subdirectory .dockerignore files are ignored by Docker during compose and root builds.
findings.impact: Potential false sense of security if developers assume subdirectory ignore files apply to root builds.
findings.recommended_remediation: Ensure all critical exclusions remain maintained in root .dockerignore.

findings.title: Worker Celery inspect ping probe vulnerable to head-of-line blocking
findings.exact_evidence: Worker runs with --concurrency=1 --pool=solo while liveness probe executes 'celery inspect ping' with timeout 30s.
findings.impact: During heavy synchronous CPU-bound task execution (e.g. 45s PDF processing), the worker cannot answer the inspect ping prompt, risking false-positive liveness probe failures.
findings.recommended_remediation: Implement file-based heartbeat probe or optimize inspect timeout thresholds.
